limitations: Samples begin after model initialization and only cover the eight repeats.

Only the three recorded PIDs were sampled, without a descendant census. Worker log records a thread job executor and all STT/prewarm events under PID44724. RSS records resident pages, not complete model allocation or attributable total stack memory.
RSS on Apple unified memory is not equivalent to model memory and separate overlapping measures must not be summed.
Sampling can miss peaks, swap pre-existed, and other application load was not controlled.
